name: Lydia
title: Europe's First Christians
summary: Lydia was a dealer in purple cloth from Thyatira who lived in Philippi. She was a God-fearing woman who already worshipped the God of Israel. When Paul came to Philippi, she was among the women gathering by the river, and the Lord opened her heart. She became the first documented Christian in Europe and offered hospitality to the missionaries.

keyEvents.title: By the River in Philippi
keyEvents.description: Lydia met Paul at the place of prayer outside the city where women gathered.

keyEvents.title: The Lord Opened Her Heart
keyEvents.description: The Lord opened Lydia's heart so that she paid attention to what Paul said.

keyEvents.title: Baptism and Hospitality
keyEvents.description: Lydia and her entire household were baptized, and she insisted that the missionaries stay at her home.
